scientific_integrity: The theorem has an all-parameter analytic proof. A stand-alone standard-library checker independently tested bivariate Gaussian moments and supplementary finite grids; the finite tests are not proof. No claimed external certification.
scientific_limitations: No non-Gaussian optimality, multistep, variable-sign particle coupling, nonlinear solver guarantee, or computational-cost optimality; generating the interior correlation uses two normals. Full text of the closest motivating article was unavailable, so historical priority is provisional.
scientific_scope: Two unbiased Gaussian heat-displacement samples, one real nonzero Fourier mode, arbitrary unknown phase, and minimax absolute variance over jointly Gaussian correlations r in [-1,1].
title: A unique interior minimax Gaussian coupling for phase-unknown heat Fourier modes
